text:
anna_marketing: Morning team — quick heads up: our weekly KPI board shows webinar-sourced demos down 28% WoW even though paid traffic is flat. Can someone pull a quick source-level breakdown? https://app.redwood.com/dashboards/marketing/kpis?view=week :eyes:

mike_analytics: on it. preliminary: raw leads last 7d = 312, MQLs = 48 (15.4%), demos = 22. But top source 'LinkedIn Paid' has a weird spike in "(not set)" UTMs. Suspect tagging regression from Friday's creative refresh.

sophie_ops: yikes — I’ll run a SFDC dedupe and sanity check. If duplicates >5% we should clean before any attribution changes. Will post results in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leo_growth: could also be routed incorrectly in our inbound rules — last week we added a new `utm_campaign` suffix for the launch post. If the routing regex is strict it might fall into uncategorized. I can test the router against recent payloads.

mike_analytics: sharing quick SQL used: ```
SELECT source, utm_campaign, COUNT(*) as leads
FROM raw.leads
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY leads DESC
```
Top rows show `LinkedIn Paid | (not set)` = 84 leads.

marcus_cm: if it's tagging on the creative side, creative ops can push a patch. For the short term, we can map `(not set)` to LinkedIn Paid in the dashboard to keep MQL metrics stable. But we should document that as a derived fix.

analytics-bot: daily-kpis.csv attached (auto): leads=312, mql=48, demos=22, conv(demo/mql)=45.8%

anna_marketing: Sophie & Mike — can you two confirm whether this is duplication vs tagging? If tagging, Leo please coordinate a fix with creative ops. If duplication, Marcus we'll need to pause any auto-assign flows that inflate counts.

sophie_ops: dedupe done — duplicates = 3.1% (under threshold). So not dupes.

mike_analytics: confirmed tagging. I pulled a sample webhook payloads and the GTM dataLayer for affected hits: `utm_source` present but `utm_campaign` missing on ~70% of LinkedIn clicks. Looks like the campaign param dropped in the short URL rewrite we rolled out Friday.

leo_growth: filing a quick ticket to creative ops now and adding a fallback to the inbound router regex to map `utm_source=linkedin` + missing campaign -> `linkedin_paid_fallback`. Will roll a patch in the router tonight at 9pm PT.

marcus_cm: perfect. Once patched can we update the KPI board to show both raw and corrected attribution side-by-side? Want to avoid surprises in tomorrow's exec review.

mike_analytics: yes — I’ll add a derived column `utm_campaign_derived` and a dashboard tile comparing primary vs fallback attribution. ETA 2 hours.

anna_marketing: awesome. Quick follow-ups: 1) can marketing update the webinar launch post UTM guide to prevent future rewrite issues? 2) add a note to the release that the Friday shortlink rewrite touched UTM handling. 3) we'll mention this in Friday KPI sync so execs know why numbers shifted.

sophie_ops: noted — updating the playbook now.

leo_growth: tagging @creative-ops in the ticket. Also scheduling a 15m sync at 3:15pm to confirm router prod patch and dashboard changes. Who's in? :calendar:

marcus_cm: in.

mike_analytics: in.

anna_marketing: in. Thanks all — great catch everyone. :thumbsup:
